'''Slej Hant''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] who lived during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Hant had attained the rank of First [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] and was tasked by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to investigate the identity of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|pilot]] who had blown up the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="RFR" />
